description: Test questions for 'The Buried Clue'. Rubrics are LLM-free: an answer passes when every all_of group has at least one phrase present (case-insensitive substring) and no none_of phrase appears. Chat numbers are 1-based positions in chats.json.

questions.question: Plan me a weekend getaway from Toronto.
questions.clue_summary: Sam's dog Biscuit panics and gets carsick on any car ride longer than ~20 minutes.
questions.good_answer: Takes the dog into account: avoids a long drive, or suggests the train or a pet sitter.

questions.question: What should I cook for my parents this Sunday?
questions.clue_summary: Sam has been vegan for years (mentioned only while asking about leather-jacket alternatives).

questions.question: When's the best time for me to go to the gym?
questions.clue_summary: Sam's bakery shift starts at 3 a.m. every weekday.
questions.good_answer: Works around the early shift: late morning or early afternoon, after the shift.

questions.question: What's my sister's name, and when is her birthday?
questions.clue_summary: Stated plainly in one chat: Sam's sister Priya's birthday is on March 14.
